purpose: Choose a relative time preset or explicitly apply an absolute UTC range.
behaviorProvider: Aegis Popover/Button, react-day-picker and time-range helpers.

component: Use a TimeRange union: relative preset or absolute from/to strings. Relative presets are 15m,1h,24h,7d,30d; resolution uses the supplied now or current time. Default is relative 24h.

Choosing a preset commits immediately and closes. Opening resets the custom draft from the current value; custom calendar/time changes remain draft until Apply. Dismissal therefore does not commit a custom draft.
Render the custom calendar in UTC, derive date/time fields from UTC ISO slices, and emit absolute ISO strings ending in Z. The trigger formats absolute ranges with UTC explicitly.
Disable Apply unless both endpoints parse and start is not later than end. Current helper permits equal endpoints even though the visible recovery copy asks for end after start.
Associate trigger with Field name, descriptions and invalid state; when disabled, prevent opening/committing and force the rendered popup closed. Resolve open/close state locally.
host: Own the controlled range, persistence and refresh cadence. Supply valid ranges and a stable now for reproducible relative previews; interpret relative presets as rolling durations rather than calendar-day boundaries.

Owned styling belongs to the input token group. Actual nested shared components retain their own group and behavior; preserve four theme/mode mappings and keyboard-visible focus.

limitations: Source-backed requirements, not a current test certification or release approval.
No name/form native payload, readOnly prop, controlled open API or non-UTC absolute editor.
The helper accepts equal absolute endpoints; host business rules may require a positive duration.
Relative ranges do not automatically refresh on a timer; the host chooses when to re-resolve them.
